; Template for pgbouncer-userlist.txt — NOT the live file.
;
; The live file lives at ./polaris_web/secrets/pgbouncer-userlist.txt
; (mode 0600; gitignored) and is generated by
; scripts/polaris-generate-secrets.sh.
;
; Format: "username" "auth-string"
;
; For SCRAM-SHA-256, auth-string is the full
; SCRAM-SHA-256$<iter>:<salt>$<storedkey>:<serverkey> value
; from Postgres's pg_shadow / pg_authid.passwd column. The generate
; script extracts it after the polaris_app role is created.
;
; Example (not real credentials):
; "polaris_app" "SCRAM-SHA-256$4096:c2FsdA==$storedkey:serverkey"
